name: The Shadowhound does not leap onto a stealthed player it cannot detect
contract: The Shadowhound's leap, its attack on landing and the Lesser Shadowhounds' owner-victim pickup checked whether the Witch Hunter could attack the target, so a stealthed player the owner detects drew the hound after them.

The hound now checks its own attack and detection. The owner carries Invisibility and Stealth Detection 18950 (aura 17, +100000) and sees a player in Stealth 1787 twenty yards away, beyond the hound's own detection;
Houndmaster's Call 802273 on that player must leave the hound beside its owner with no victim (before the fix it leapt onto the player and attacked).

steps.label: Let login and class synchronisation settle
Fixture: the Witch Hunter detects stealth
Fixture: the player is in Stealth
SETUP: the Witch Hunter can attack the stealthed player
SETUP: the player is stealthed when the hounds are called
Houndmaster's Call on the stealthed player
Give a leap time to land
DISCRIMINATING: the Shadowhound has not taken the stealthed player as its victim
The Shadowhound stayed beside its owner
